record.one_liner: Intercom is a customer service platform combining a messenger, shared inbox, help center and the Fin AI agent for support, engagement and sales conversations.
record.auth_notes: Access Token (static, tied to the installing teammate) for private apps on your own workspace, sent as Authorization: Bearer. OAuth is required for public apps accessing other people's workspaces; asking users for tokens violates ToS.
record.access_notes: A free development workspace (US only, dev-only, 20 user/lead cap, cannot convert to production) lets you create a public OAuth app and get an access token. Private apps against your own production data need a paid Intercom workspace. Not verified: whether a public OAuth app needs App Store review before installs by other customers (not confirmed in fetched pages). Rate limits page returned 404, so not verified.
record.blocker: Private-app tokens need a paid workspace; the free dev workspace is limited (US only, 20 contacts, no conversion to production). Public OAuth apps for customers: App Store/review requirements and rate limits not verified. The official MCP does not support AU workspaces, and custom OAuth redirect URIs beyond localhost need Intercom support to allowlist.
